agency-4g.description: Agency on a small host with a separately provisioned substrate; not a complete local stack.
agency-4g.workload: One agent at a time; no local frontend compilation or Lean builds.

compact-8g.description: First qualification candidate for a complete headless two-JVM installation.
compact-8g.workload: One agent at a time, fresh/small store; full-corpus rebuilds require separate qualification.

rebuild-16g.description: Compact Agency with the current substrate rebuild memory ceilings.
rebuild-16g.workload: Substrate rebuild qualification; agent and compiler concurrency must be bounded.

zone-32g.description: Existing Zone JVM ceilings, retained as a large-host option.
zone-32g.workload: Large-host trial; this does not certify unrestricted concurrent agents or proof builds.
